port.ask: Serial port the balance is on (COM5, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: RS-232 socket on the balance with a straight cable to a USB-serial adapter, or the balance's own USB port (appears as a virtual COM port with the Mettler Toledo driver).

baud.ask: Baud rate as set in the balance's interface menu (factory 9600)
